about: The one palette of J-Stars Victory VS-EX: the fan site (tools/site/site.py), the README badges (tools/site/badges.py), the banner, social preview, logo mark and dividers (tools/site/repo_art.py) and the installer wizard images and icons (installer/tools/installer_art.py). Our own colours for a menu look drawn from scratch: speed-line burst, red and white stripe frame, slanted dark panels, a yellow-to-orange highlight. Hex values only; every pair in 'pairs' is checked for contrast by tools/site/check_site.py.
